chapter: Decline of funeral bands and societies
title: Why fewer musicians and funerals today
summary: Henry says good musicians died, young players do not take it up, and fewer clubs and societies mean fewer funerals.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship
